content:
maya: Kicking off bring-up for `rwd-v6-int4-stablepin`. Objective: validate KV-cache fidelity and structured-output stability after NF4->INT4 quant profile. Rolling to a tiny stable cohort: 0.5% stable, 0.1% pilot, 99.4% holdback. Observability + deltas enabled.

sam: pls paste the rollout config so SRE can sanity-check autoscaling/burst behavior.

maya: here is the quick config we used:
```
strategy:
  stable_pin: true
  cohorts:
    - name: stable
      pct: 0.5
    - name: pilot
      pct: 0.1
    - name: holdback
      pct: 99.4
metrics:
  - name: hallucination_rate
    baseline: 0.008
    alert_delta_abs: 0.005
  - name: prefix_kv_mismatch
    threshold: 0.015
  - name: mrr_delta_pct
    alert_delta_pct: 1.0
fallback_policy: immediate_on_metric_breach
```

deploy-bot: deploy rwd-v6-int4-stablepin -> pilot cohorts started (canary id: c-9142). :package:

eval-bot: initial sample (10k requests across docs/qa/topk slices): median latency +6ms, p95 +18ms, token-cost -12% vs baseline. hallucination_rate baseline 0.8% -> 1.15% (delta +0.35% absolute). prefix_kv_mismatch measured 0.012 on sample set.

olivia: saw a small MRR dip on longform-docs slice: -0.7% on a 5k sample. Not huge but noticeable for that slice. prefix_kv_mismatch 0.012 matches eval-bot.

leo: quick thoughts: cost/latency win looks good. Quality signal is marginal but under our alert thresholds as-written. Recommend tightening for early-stage: if hallucination_rate delta_abs >0.005 OR prefix_kv_mismatch >0.015 OR mrr_delta_pct >1.0 then immediate fallback to pinned baseline and page on-call. Also add a short TTL window (5m) for transient spikes to avoid noisy flips.

maya: agree on TTL. Suggest we add a secondary gate that compares structured-output schema failures (JSON parse errors, missing keys) — those are sticky. If structured_fail_rate >0.2% -> immediate rollback.

sam: i'll run a KV-warm shadow test against a 50k historical trace to stress cold-starts and duplication edgecases. @olivia can you add a focused evalset for longform with anchor prompts?

olivia: on it. will push an eval slice (anchor+perturb) in next hour. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

leo: also add an SLO-lift guard for tail latency: if p99 increases >40ms for stable cohort we pause promotion.

maya: noted. Updated action items: 1) sam run shadow KV-warm test (50k) 2) olivia push longform eval slice 3) add structured_fail_rate metric + TTL gating 4) tighten immediate fallback thresholds as leo suggested. We'll hold promotion for 24h and then +0.5% -> 1% -> 5% if signals remain green.

eval-bot: queued continuous checks: hallucination_rate, prefix_kv_mismatch, structured_fail_rate, mrr_delta_pct, p99_tail. Will post hourly deltas.

sam: starting shadow job now. will post logs/summary once done. :eyes:

maya: thanks team. if any metric breaches during the holdback window, fallback_policy = immediate and on-call page. otherwise proceed with step promotions after 24h.

leo: :thumbsup: keep an eye on correlated regressions (e.g., prefix mismatch + structured_fail). those often indicate quant-induced tokenizer/kv alignment issues.

maya: logging this thread into the rollout ticket. will update with eval-bot hourly reports.

(End of thread)
